Segment information
Operating
segments are reported based on the financial information provided
to the Chief Executive Officer and the responsibilities of the
Executive Committee (formerly known as the GSK Leadership Team).
GSK reports results under two segments: Commercial Operations and
Total R&D. Members of the Executive Committee are responsible
